about_short_description.short_description: Alpheya is a software company that delivers cloud-native, AI-powered wealthtech solutions for private banks, and investment houses.

product.name: Digital Client Experience
product.description: A cloud-native platform providing hyper-personalized web and mobile applications for client engagement, onboarding, and self-directed trading tailored to the MENA region.

product.name: Wealth Relationship Management
product.description: A CRM system for relationship managers providing client, account, and portfolio insights, task and workflow management, and AI-powered client opportunity identification.

product.name: Portfolio Management and Execution
product.description: A platform for advisors enabling financial planning, risk assessment, discretionary portfolio management, portfolio analysis, and order execution with AI assistance.

product.name: Financial Marketplace
product.description: A digital marketplace offering access to global asset classes, pre-built integrations with funds and alternative products, and curated market data and research.

product.name: Digital Reporting and Analytics
product.description: A reporting and analytics platform delivering client retention and growth analytics, performance reporting, attribution analysis, and KPI metrics.
